_comment: The single declaration of what Memberistic claims compatibility with.
The integration workflow builds its matrix from `blocking` x `php` and
refuses to run when any blocking version is not published on
wordpress.org — a matrix naming a version that does not exist reports
green for coverage it never had.
`readme_tested_up_to` is asserted against readme.txt by the same job, so
'Tested up to' can only ever name a line the blocking matrix actually
exercised. Raising it means adding the release to `blocking` first and
watching the full matrix pass — never the other way round.
`canary` is advisory. A green canary is not support.
